note: `studded` and `prepared_rows` prove the same smallness Owed(O v - F) at a_N^(1/16) with subpower coefficient on full tails (and `onionsT` on ordered tails), absorbing the slow factor through 1/16 < gamma; the two a_N^(-1/32) factors, the a_N^(1/32) tolerance and the symmetry images are not displayed.

lemma studded {F:Trial C}{E:Cutoffs→ℝ}{ζ:ℕ→ℕ→ℝ}(d:ℕ)(H':Sluggish C E) (ht:Stencil F)
    (hP:∀ᶠ i in FullVolume.mesh, ∀ m k:ℕ,C.ref d ≤ k → k < i.1 → Stock.Tabs.opens C.path.levels 1 m k → ∀ h:m ≤ i.1,(center C.S i.2 h 0).rootTest (C.beta i.1 i.2) (F i.1 i.2 0) ≤ cider C ζ d m k*E i*flight C (-Push.RelayDifference.gamma) i) : Owed F (flight C (-(1/16))) :=by
   refine ⟨ht,?_⟩
   filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (C.ref d)] with m hm
   let k:= Stock.Tabs.chosen C.path.levels 1 B m; have hk:Stock.Tabs.opens C.path.levels 1 m k:= Stock.Tabs.opened _ _ _ _
   have he := (Sluggish.const (cider C ζ d m k)).mul H'; have hx:= he.sink (show 1/16 < γ by norm_num [RelayDifference.gamma]);
   filter_upwards [hx,hP,deepen.eventually (eventually_gt_atTop k), ht.at_origin m] with i hi hp ht hv; obtain ⟨hn,hN⟩:= hv; exact ⟨hn,hN, (hp m k (hm.trans hk.1) ht hk hn).trans hi⟩

proof_context.conclusion: Eventually in the cutoffs, a root-test bound `cider*E*flight(-gamma)` with `E` slow and `1/16 < gamma` yields `Owed F (flight (-(1/16)))`, the a_N^(1/16) smallness.

lemma prepared_rows {F:Trial C} (hG:G.Simple)(hF:Fridge C u ζ)(hp : ∀ᶠ i in FullVolume.mesh, Continuous (F i.1 i.2 0)) (hv:Stencil F) (he:Tucked F d) : ∃ v:Rowe C d, Coin C v ∧ Owed (upper C v - F) (flight C (-(1/16))) := by
  obtain ⟨E,hE,hh⟩ := newPersist H hG hF.full (borrowed (W:=fun i=> Real.exp ((C.path.levels.budget i).supportExponent)) (roof_of_tabs B)) hF.candle (borrowed (W:=fun i=>(u i)⁻¹) (hF.path _)) (borrowed (W:=fun i => ζ d i) (hF.smoke d _)) (fun i hi => (h.grows _ _ hi).le) he hp
  exact readyCoin H B h hE hv hh

proof_context.conclusion: A continuous stencilled `F` gives `v` with `Coin v` (subpower coefficient) and `Owed (O v - F)` at rate `a_N^(1/16)`.
